siteName: Lunar South Pole — Shackleton Crater Rim & Wall (LRO LOLA GDR)
verticalDatum: Lunar Reference Sphere R = 1,737,400 m (GRAIL GRGM 900C)

provenance.datasetName: LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record (LDEM_75S_30M & LDEM_64, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0)
provenance.provider: NASA GSFC / MIT LOLA Team / PDS Geosciences Node
provenance.instrumentOrMission: Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) — Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA)
provenance.processingPerformed: Direct binary subset extraction via HTTP Range request from PDS Geosciences LOLA GDR polar stereographic 16-bit LSB integer grid (DN * 0.5 m relative to 1737.4 km reference sphere).
provenance.resamplingMethod: Native 30.0 m/pix Polar Stereographic grid (no synthetic interpolation)
provenance.limitations: Represents bare regolith topography relative to 1,737.4 km sphere; sub-30 m boulders require LROC NAC stereo DTMs.
